answer_1.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our framework through various open domain QA datasets, encompassing both general tasks including Natural Questions (NQ) , TriviaQA (TQA) as well as domain-specific tasks like MMLU.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the Recall@Topk (k = 10, 20) for retriever performance, measuring whether the answer match a text span within the Top-k retrieved passages. For the overall precision, we consider accuracy (Acc.), verifying whether the answer generated by the RALM exactly matches the ground true answer in the dataset.
